title: Neverfail Springwater - proposed acquisition of Palm Springs Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced that it would not oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Market definition: The relevant markets are regional markets in Queensland, New South Wales, ACT and Victoria for the supply of bottled and filtered water.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The acquisition is unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in any regional markets for the supply of bottled and filtered water. In particular, barriers to entry appear to be relatively low and a number of competitors supplying either bottled water or water filtration units will remain.
